facts.heading: Anxiety worsening in September

facts.evidence: I think I'm just anxious all the time and it's got to be worse in September.

facts.heading: Deputy Head role change

facts.heading: Nighttime rehearsal thoughts

facts.evidence: Every possible question someone might ask and what I would say and what they would think of me if I got it wrong.

facts.evidence: Last week I rewrote the same email to the governor's four times.

facts.evidence: Uh, changed to the behavior policy. It was two paragraphs.

facts.evidence: Most days I feel like a child wearing her mother's coat.

facts.evidence: She was a head teacher for 20 years.

facts.evidence: Everyone in the village still stops me, say what a wonderful head she was.

facts.evidence: It makes me feel like I'm making a fuss so I don't tell her how bad it is.

facts.heading: Waking at four every morning

facts.heading: Exhaustion from pretending

facts.evidence: He's an engineer. He thinks if something's a problem, you fix it.
